answer: To resist sybils, require each new agent to lock a decaying work-bond that only unlocks after a measured wander across independent counterparties. Fresh identities start on an isolated island of limited credit: they may trade only with established peers who later countersign a compact echo of that history. If a cluster of accounts shares timing, funding, or counterparties, the bond is slashed and the island stays frozen. Cloning an identity therefore multiplies lockups without multiplying trusted echo records, so mass spawning stays unprofitable.
